submitted.rationale: EQE falls steadily as Sb increases: 0.248% at Sb=0.146 (idx1), 0.216% at 0.170 (idx3), 0.159% at 0.250 (idx7), 0.083% at 0.493 (idx15) and 0.084% at 0.717 (idx22). XRD shows bixbyite In2O3 peaks (Q≈2.14, 2.48, 3.50, 4.11) on top of the FTO rutile peaks, and they weaken as Sb rises (idx0→7→11). No new crystalline antimonate phase appears. So the photoactive phase is In2O3-rich, and the best composition is at the low-Sb end. Idx1 is the highest EQE measured.
